summary.text: Mary Fosse is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 38-Position 2 since January 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mary Fosse lives in Everett, Washington, and earned a degree from Whitman College in 2005.
Her career experience includes working as a small business owner and as a legislative staffer in the Washington House of Representatives.
Fosse was elected to the Everett City Council and served as an Everett districting commissioner and Council of Neighborhoods representative.
She assumed office in the Washington House on January 9, 2023.
